decision.explanation: The question asks what position(s) Pierre-Paul Boësnier de l'Orme currently or formerly holds. Document D1S2 explicitly states that he is the first French national to hold the position of Member of the South Australian House of Assembly, supporting 'Member of the South Australian House of Assembly'. Document D2S1 and D2S16 describe his appointment to the position of Vice President, supporting 'Vice President'. Both positions are distinct and valid based on the provided sources. There is no contradiction between the two roles, and both are directly stated in the original texts.
